Name: (AT) Additional Aymeric Slightly Cuter Style Spouse Portraits - Backdoor Edition
Author: octopathtraversing
Description:
"Oh my, seems you've found the backdoor to the Traveling Cart and gained access to portraits of the Lord Speaker in various situations he may have preferred left forgotten. How did the traveling merchant wind up with so much potential blackmail, we may never know.

All I advise is to keep the retired Lord Speaker himself from ever seeing them if you wish to keep them. Otherwise, you might find yourself sitting down to a very disgruntled husband who insists you must speak with him about where and when you got these portraits."


Of course, this is only an AT mod that changes textures. Aymeric will likely look at the spouse portraits like any old portrait and walk away. The comedy is in having him see it and never comment on it at all. The poor man, married to someone putting up compromising portraits of him where he now lives.

This mod requires the Content Patcher [CP] mod Aymeric Slightly Cuter Style Spouse Portrait for the Traveling Cart to work, but serves as a replacement for the [AT] Additional Aymeric Slightly Cuter Style Spouse Portraits, as it contains all the textures in the general [AT] mod along with 7 new mature portraits placed here for the blood and violence content.

[b][u]Credit:

[/u][/b]Credit to Poltergeister for the Slightly Cuter Aymeric Sprites that served as the base for creating these spouse portrait textures.
Major credit to Adaire99 for the Aymeric de Borel mod to whose character these spouse portrait textures are for.
Spouse portrait textures themselves are done by me.
